name: Nothing Like You
source:
After a mission gone wrong, you (prodigy pilot Intravenous) were critically injured and rushed in for emergency medical care. Post-Op, one of the student nurses who volunteered to treat you, inadvertently learned your secret in the process... after which you proceeded to ask her for a date.

This is that date.

[From [url=https://pride-col.itch.io/nothing-like-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一次任务出错后，你（神童飞行员静脉）受了重伤，被紧急送往医院接受紧急医疗救治。术后，其中一位自愿为你治疗的实习护士无意间得知了你的秘密……之后你开始向她提出约会。

这就是那个日期。

[来自[url=https://pride-col.itch.io/nothing-like-you]itch.io[/url]]
